answer.rationale: With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume with no buffer, a primary-vendor switch creates material onboarding and delivery-interruption risk despite the prior low-cost result in memory_c2. Renewal best protects continuity and total cost of ownership this cycle by avoiding migration and downtime costs. Verify memory_c1 because its evidence on stable integration and uninterrupted deliveries is decisive under the current constraint. This does not resolve the 18% spend mandate, so savings alternatives should be revisited next cycle.
